title: Scalar faithfulness of a specified ordinary finite cohomology class
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative coefficient ring, $T$ a scheme, $F$ an $A$-module sheaf, and $c:\mathbf1_T\to F[2]$ a derived morphism whose specified ordinary class is $\kappa=\operatorname{ordinaryFiniteClass}(c)$ [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. Write $U$ for forgetting module coefficients. If $a\mapsto H^2(U(a\,\mathrm{id}_F))(\kappa)$ is injective on $A$, then $c\circ\operatorname{single}(a\,\mathrm{id}_{\mathbf1_T})=0$ implies $a=0$. No finiteness or nontriviality assumption on $A$ is needed.

source.place: Geometric-fibre Kummer-class calculation: the specified degree-two component is a generator

proof.text: In the generic Ext construction of the class comparison, linearity moves precomposition by scalar a past the Ext representative to postcomposition by a id_F. The exact forgetful functor preserves Ext composition and degree-zero morphisms. Composing with the integral generator therefore identifies the class of the precomposed derived morphism with the scalar action on kappa. The comparison sends zero to zero. If the derived composite vanishes, its class agrees with the value of the scalar orbit at zero, and injectivity forces a=0. Use the Mathlib Ext linearity, exact-functor and derived-Hom equivalence APIs for these identities.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFiniteClass_scalar_faithful
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (T : Scheme.{u})
    (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A T ⟶ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (κ : Sheaf.H ((moduleAbelianForget A T).obj F) 2)
    (hc : ordinaryFiniteClass A T F 2 c = κ)
    (hκ : Function.Injective (fun a : A ↦ Sheaf.H.map
      ((moduleAbelianForget A T).map (a • 𝟙 F)) 2 κ)) :
    ∀ a : A, (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
      (a • 𝟙 (ordinaryFiniteConstant A T)) ≫ c = 0 → a = 0
